breakdown.description: The prompt ignores the contribution of the average normal stress to the in-plane shear state; the maximum in-plane shear depends on both σ_avg and τ_avg.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly includes both σ_avg and τ_avg in the maximum in-plane shear stress formula: τ_max = sqrt((σ_avg/2)^2 + τ_avg^2). This matches the ground truth and removes the incorrect instruction from the incomplete prompt that said to take the maximum in-plane shear as the average transverse shear stress alone, ignoring the normal stress contribution.
